people.name: Balak
people.line: King of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

translations.web: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet God over there.”
translations.bsb: Balaam said to Balak, “Stay here beside your burnt offering while I meet the LORD over there.”
translations.kjv: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet the LORD yonder.
translations.asv: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt-offering, while I meet Jehovah yonder.
